body:
I tested a bunch of code editors and some online sites and all but one of them keep the spaces to keep the formatting the same. Doing this makes sure converting back to spaces gives the same result, no info is lost.
Since this method is exposed as well, I don't think this is the correct approach.

Instead I think we should improve the auto indent (`EDIT_AUTO_INDENT` `GDScriptLanguage::auto_indent_code`) and switch to use that.
